Explicit-ask bypass

Measured on 13 real prompts from one session · 2026-07-26

The finding

The operator typed "vis in ascii emojies" six times. The nudge answered twice. The other four were silenced by a throttle designed to prevent noise on implicit requests — and applied, wrongly, to the most explicit request that exists.

  before  ✅ · ✅ · · · · · · · · ·      2 / 13
  after   ✅ ✅ ✅ · ✅ ✅ · · · ✅ · · ·   6 / 13

Prompt-by-prompt replay

#prompt (verbatim) beforeafterkind
1vis in ascii emojies status and decision…✅✅explicit
2vis in ascii emojies explanation✗ quiet✅explicit
3status? vis in ascii emojies✗ quiet✅explicit
4so whats next for us?··implicit throttled, correct
5explain whats left on track b in ascii emojies✗ quiet✅explicit
6so whats next? vis ascii emojies✗ quiet✅explicit
7how related to yonatan-hq and candlekeep explain··implicit throttled, correct
8so what would you do better?··no match rule carried it
9show me optinos and whats most correct··implicit throttled, correct
10why not haiku it? vis options and why✅✅explicit
11which model is running it btw? thw skill··no match
12still failed 3164··no match
13merge··no match

Prompt 8 is the control. It matched nothing, the nudge stayed silent, and the answer was still rendered as ASCII — the always-on rule carried it alone. That is the evidence the rule and the nudge are doing different jobs, and why widening the regex was rejected.

The split

EXPLICIT_ASK_RE   vis · ascii · emoji · diagram · chart · sketch · draw
                  never throttled — the user already asked

IMPLICIT_SHAPE_RE status · options · explain · compare · trade-offs · …
                  throttle-8 kept — firing on every "status" is noise

Mutation-checked

  • remove the bypass → 2 tests fail
  • bypass everything → 3 tests fail
  • restore → 14/14 pass

Gates

  • hooks 7407 pass / 301 files
  • tests/skills 51 / 0
  • tests/evals 6 / 0
  • security 17 / 17

Bonus, pre-existing. Writing real cases surfaced that rules/status-glyph-vocabulary.md had no test case at all — the bidirectional coverage check had been warning about it and nobody had acted. Added one. Traceability went 8/8 → 11/11 and the warning is gone.

Honest scope

  • Measured: the 13-prompt replay, both before and after, through the real built bundle — not the unit-test path.
  • Not measured: whether throttle-8 is the right number for implicit prompts. It was picked by judgment and only 3 implicit prompts appeared in this sample.
  • Deliberately unchanged: the regex was not widened. Prompt 8 shows the rule already covers what the regex misses.
